name: King's Angel: Otome
source:
Recently named the king's personal bard, you wake up on the palace floor. The kingdom has been reduced to ruin by a magical force, making nearly all of its residents disappear.

You meet several others who still cling to life - Calix, the guardian angel gone astray, Madion, the jester who resents and hounds you, Edwina the shady alchemist... Most of these individuals struggle with memory loss, but still, they are hiding secrets.

You soon discover that the magical curse makes the world reset and loop - but you can change what happens in every reincarnation.

Discover what happened to the kingdom, find love, work your way out of the curse, and choose your ending!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4028510/Kings_Angel_Otome/]Steam[/url]]
